definitions.gloss: opening a business; starting a practice
definitions.explanation: Beginning to operate a business, especially a professional practice such as a medical clinic, law office, or other professional service.

examples.japanese: {医師|いし}として{開業|かいぎょう}した。
examples.english: He opened his own medical practice.

examples.japanese: {父|ちち}は{弁護士|べんごし}として{独立|どくりつ}{開業|かいぎょう}している。
examples.english: My father runs his own independent law practice.

examples.japanese: この{鉄道|てつどう}は1920{年|ねん}に{開業|かいぎょう}し、{今|いま}も{多|おお}くの{人|ひと}に{利用|りよう}されている。
examples.english: This railway began operating in 1920 and is still used by many people today.

notes:
USAGE:
{開業|かいぎょう} is commonly used for professional practices (doctors, lawyers, accountants) and also for railways, bridges, and other infrastructure beginning operation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開業|かいぎょう}する (to open a business/practice)
- {開業|かいぎょう}{医|い} (doctor with a private practice)
- {開業|かいぎょう}{届|とどけ} (business registration notification)
- {独立|どくりつ}{開業|かいぎょう} (setting up an independent practice)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {開業|かいぎょう}: starting a business or practice (broader, includes professions and infrastructure)
- {開店|かいてん}: opening a store (specifically retail)
- {創業|そうぎょう}: founding a company (emphasizes the historical beginning)
